description: This is a React component file that implements an explore view with a mind map visualization for roles related to a persona. It fetches role recommendations, filters roles based on user-selected criteria, maintains view state, and renders a mind map canvas along with a details panel.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an input value to a trimmed string, replacing undefined or null with empty string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into a sanitized string array, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID from a role object using various possible property names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title from a role object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a number within a provided min and max range.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary information from a role object to extract minimum and maximum salary in lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches the selected industry, skills, and salary filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations for a given persona ID, with fallback logic.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts stored view state into viewport configuration.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport configuration and selected node ID into view state for persistence.
